signals.headline: Announced $25M Series A funding round
signals.quote: We're announcing a $25 million Series A, bringing our total funding to $35 million.
signals.how_to_use: Reference their recent Series A funding announcement as a natural milestone to review their directors and officers (D&O) coverage limits and risk posture.
signals.found_by: Looks up the company's Form D filings, which are due within 15 days of a first sale, and searches news for the round announcement.
signals.why_it_matters: Investors commonly require D&O within 60 to 90 days of close, and new board seats mean new personal liability.
signals.angle: Investors commonly require D&O within 60 to 90 days of close. Ask whether D&O is already in place for the new board.

signals.headline: Launched runtime security platform capabilities for enterprise AI agents
signals.quote: Today, we're launching the first security platform purpose-built for Enterprise Agents.
signals.how_to_use: Connect their product launch protecting autonomous AI execution workflows to specialized AI Liability and Tech E&O coverage.
signals.found_by: Searches news for launch announcements and reads the company's blog and product pages.
signals.why_it_matters: AI output is a new kind of liability, and buyers now ask about it in security reviews.
signals.angle: Customers ask how AI output is covered. Ask whether AI liability is part of their Tech E&O today.

signals.headline: Published customer logos and enterprise security use cases for major institutions
signals.quote: At Dun & Bradstreet, our AI workloads run everywhere. We needed security that delivers coverage at the application layer
signals.how_to_use: Undated, so supporting evidence only. Acknowledge their ongoing push into large enterprise workflows (such as Dun & Bradstreet, H&R Block, and Lemonade) as a prompt to evaluate comprehensive Tech E&O and Cyber Liability policies.
signals.found_by: Reads every open role and flags enterprise-sales, solutions and compliance titles. Fetches the company's security, trust, customers and enterprise pages.
signals.why_it_matters: Enterprise procurement asks for a certificate of insurance before signing. This is usually the first hard insurance deadline a startup hits, and a deal is waiting on it.
signals.angle: Enterprise customers ask for a certificate of insurance (Tech E&O and cyber) before they sign. Ask whether a deal is waiting on one.

signals.headline: Active hiring for go-to-market and engineering roles
signals.quote: We're actively recruiting for both go-to-market and engineering roles. If you like what we do, reach out.
signals.how_to_use: Undated, so supporting evidence only. Tie their active team expansion to reviewing Employment Practices Liability (EPL) and Workers' Comp coverage as headcount scales.
signals.found_by: Reads the location of every open role and counts the distinct US states.
signals.why_it_matters: Workers' comp is required state by state, from the first employee in each one. Headcount growth also raises employment-practices risk.
signals.angle: Each new state with an employee needs workers' comp there. Ask whether coverage follows the hiring plan.
